title: acapella_merged_under_code.md
content:
# Acapella Code Merge Note

The Vocal + Acapella Studio is no longer presented as a separate user-facing page in this build. Its useful export concepts are merged under the NPC Voice Lab workflow:

- local WAV rendering
- MP3 backend conversion payloads
- vocal-only / no-instruments safety fields
- audio export naming and format handling

The original acapella files remain in the archive for audit/reference, but `index.html` now opens only the NPC Voice Lab.
